props.name: approverSource
props.comment: Record field holding the approver list, a top-level key. Default `"approvers"`.

props.name: statusSource
props.comment: Record field the status is written to, a top-level key. Default `"status"`.

props.name: pendingValue
props.comment: Status written while approvals are short of `required`. Default `"pending"`.

props.name: approvedValue
props.comment: Status written once approvals reach `required`. Default `"approved"`.

props.name: mutationMode
props.comment: How the update is dispatched. Default `"pessimistic"`.
